propositions: Implement self-contained scc LOC/size analyzer that shells out to 'scc --format json' and parses per-file Code and Location fields without coupling to grounding layer.
Parse nested scc JSON structure (language groups → per-file entries) and flatten to repo-relative POSIX-normalized file paths with LOC counts and max_loc.
Return Unavailable (fail-closed) on missing scc binary, non-zero exit, empty/unparseable output; return empty AnalyzerResult (not Unavailable) for successful zero-file trees.
Inject subprocess runner for testability so unit tests use canned scc JSON without requiring live scc binary.
Align _ACCRUING_SINCE constant with existing metrics reader modules (git_metrics.py, event_metrics.py).
